groups.title: Checking the roof
groups.passage:
F1: Thanks for coming. A stain appeared above our reception desk after last night's rain. We're opening another office next month, so a new roof would be hard to afford.
M1: I'll check the roof first. Fallen leaves can stop rainwater from flowing off a roof that is otherwise fine.

F1: That's a relief. Please take photos of anything you find, so I can show the manager why the work was needed.

F1：謝謝你趕來。昨晚下雨後，我們接待桌上方出現了污漬。下個月還要開另一處辦公室，換新屋頂恐怕負擔不起。
M1：我會先檢查屋頂。即使屋頂本身沒問題，落葉仍可能堵住雨水流出的路。
F1：大樓管理員看到屋頂上有一堆濕落葉。客戶陸續抵達時，你可以上樓嗎？
M1：我會走後面的樓梯，避開大廳。如果把堵塞清掉，你可能就不用換屋頂。
F1：那我就放心了。你發現什麼都請拍照，我好向管理員說明為什麼有必要施工。

groups.title: A research presentation
groups.passage: M1: Our survey of remote workers produced a result we hadn't expected. We assumed that most respondents would want faster internet service. Instead, the most common request was access to a quiet workspace near home. Many people said that family activity made it difficult to concentrate, even when their internet connection was reliable. Based on this finding, we recommend testing a shared workspace program in two residential neighborhoods. The trial would use meeting rooms in existing community centers, so no new buildings would be required. Participants would reserve desks through a simple online calendar. Before choosing the locations, however, we need to interview the center managers about opening hours and accessibility. The full survey results are available in the report circulated this morning.

groups.title: Returning reusable shipping crates
groups.titleZh: 可重複使用運輸箱回收通知
groups.passage:
To: Regional store managers
Subject: Reusable crate collection

Beginning next Monday, our distribution center will collect reusable shipping crates during regular deliveries. The new arrangement is intended to reduce packaging waste without adding a separate collection trip. Please ask your receiving team to [131] ____ empty crates by size and place them near the loading entrance before the driver arrives.

Each crate carries a small identification label. Drivers will scan these labels and provide a digital receipt showing how many crates were collected. [132] ____ Please check it against your own records before the truck leaves. If a label is missing, set the crate aside and report the problem through the inventory portal.

Stores will not be charged for normal wear. However, crates damaged by improper storage may incur a replacement fee. To prevent such damage, keep all crates indoors, [133] ____ from heaters and direct sunlight. We will review the program after six weeks and make any [134] ____ adjustments based on your feedback.
groups.passageZh:
收件者：各區門市經理
主旨：可重複使用運輸箱回收

下週一起，配送中心將在例行送貨時回收可重複使用的運輸箱。新安排旨在減少包材浪費，不必另行安排回收車次。請收貨團隊依尺寸 [131] ____ 空箱，並在司機抵達前放到裝卸入口附近。

每個箱子都有識別標籤。司機會掃描標籤，提供載明回收數量的電子收據。[132] ____ 請在貨車離開前，將這張收據與您自己的紀錄核對。如標籤遺失，請將箱子放一旁，透過庫存系統回報。

正常耗損不向門市收費；但因存放不當造成損壞，可能須支付更換費。為避免這類損壞，請將所有運輸箱放在室內，並 [133] ____ 暖氣設備與陽光直射處。我們會在六週後檢討計畫，根據各位回饋作出 [134] ____ 調整。

groups.title: A quieter place to work
groups.passage:
Harbor Library Member Update

Following a survey of members, Harbor Library is converting the former map room into a quiet workspace. Construction will begin on June 3 and is expected to last two weeks. The map collection has already been moved to the second-floor reference area, where it remains [135] ____ during normal opening hours.

The new room will contain twelve desks, each equipped with a power outlet and an adjustable lamp. Members may reserve a desk online for up to three hours per day. Telephone calls and group discussions will not be permitted. [136] ____ A separate meeting room on the ground floor will continue to accommodate those activities.

Because demand is likely to be high, please cancel a reservation promptly if your plans change. Desks that remain unoccupied for fifteen minutes after the reserved start time will be [137] ____ to other members. Library staff will demonstrate the booking system on opening day. Anyone who needs assistance before then can speak with a librarian [138] ____ visiting the information desk.
groups.passageZh:
海港圖書館會員消息

依據會員調查結果，海港圖書館將把原地圖室改為安靜工作空間。施工將於六月三日開始，預計持續兩週。地圖館藏已移至二樓參考資料區，在正常開館時間仍 [135] ____。

新房間有十二張書桌，每張均設電源插座與可調式檯燈。會員每天可在線上預約最多三小時。室內不得通電話或進行團體討論。[136] ____ 一樓獨立會議室將繼續提供這些活動使用。

由於需求可能很高，若計畫有變，請即時取消預約。預約開始後十五分鐘仍無人使用的書桌，將 [137] ____ 給其他會員。開放當天，館員將示範預約系統。在開放前需要協助的人，可以在 [138] ____ 服務台時向館員詢問。

The Willow Court Reuse Cooperative is holding a Saturday repair morning. Each table booking covers one item and up to two people, including the person who brings it. groups.title: A market clock finds a new home
groups.passage:
NORTH QUAY NEIGHBOURHOOD BULLETIN
A MARKET CLOCK FINDS A NEW HOME

When North Quay's old fish market closed, the clock from the wall beside the gate was saved. It goes on display at the library this Saturday. Volunteers cleaned the glass but left a scrape on the case near the number six. An old photograph in the display shows a porter pushing a trolley piled with crates past the clock. A former porter told us that the corners of the crates often brushed the clock as they went through the gate.

The volunteers fixed the hands at 6:10, the time the traders closed the gate for the last time. “At last, the clock gets to knock off, too,” the librarian joked. If you need the current time, use the working clock above the library entrance.

Anyone who remembers the market is invited to record a short story with a volunteer on Saturday. You can also bring a copy of a photo for the display. The library cannot scan photos at the event and will not accept originals, even for a short loan.
groups.passageZh:
北碼頭社區通訊
市場老時鐘有了新家

北碼頭的舊魚市場結束營業時，大家保留了大門旁牆上的時鐘。這座時鐘將於本週六在圖書館展出。志工擦乾淨了鐘面的玻璃，但保留外框靠近數字六的刮痕。展出的一張老照片中，一位搬運工推著堆滿貨箱的手推車經過時鐘。一名前搬運工告訴我們，貨箱通過大門時，箱角常擦到時鐘。

志工把指針固定在六點十分，那是攤商最後一次關上市場大門的時間。圖書館員開玩笑說：「這下連時鐘也終於能下班啦。」如果你想知道現在幾點，請看圖書館入口上方那座還在走的時鐘。

只要對這座市場還有印象，都可以在週六請志工錄下一小段你的故事。你也可以帶照片的副本來參展。活動現場無法掃描照片，圖書館也不收原件，即使只借一下也不行。

groups.title: The moving bookshop
groups.passage:
LOCAL BUSINESS: A NEW CHAPTER FOR MOSS BOOKS

After fifteen years on Hill Street, Moss Books will move into the former station ticket office in August. Owner Nadia Bell says the move is not a response to declining sales. “We have outgrown our present shop. At author events, people often stand outside because there are no seats left.”

The new premises will include a reading room with forty seats and a separate children's section. The historic ticket windows will remain, but the former luggage counter will become a coffee bar operated by an independent café. The bookshop itself will not sell food.

Moss Books will close its Hill Street doors on July 24 and reopen at the station on August 3. Online orders will continue throughout the move, although dispatch may take two days longer than usual. Bell hopes customers will help carry a symbolic chain of books between the two sites on opening morning. Volunteers can register at the current shop until July 20.
groups.passageZh:
地方商業：Moss 書店的新篇章

在 Hill Street 經營十五年後，Moss 書店將於八月搬進舊車站售票處。店主 Nadia Bell 表示，搬遷不是因為銷售下滑。「目前的店面已不敷使用，作家活動時常有人因為沒座位而站在外面。」

新址有四十個座位的閱讀室與獨立兒童區。歷史售票窗口將保留，但原行李櫃檯會改成由獨立咖啡店經營的咖啡吧，書店本身不賣食物。

Hill Street 店於七月二十四日關閉，八月三日在車站重開。搬遷期間仍可網購，但出貨時間可能比平常多等兩天。Bell 希望開幕當天早上由顧客組成人龍，在兩地間象徵性傳遞書籍。志工可於最遲於七月二十日在現址登記。

groups.title: Conference reimbursement policy
groups.passage:
STAFF DEVELOPMENT OFFICE
Conference reimbursement: revised procedure

Employees attending a job-related conference may claim the registration fee and standard rail fare, provided their department manager approves attendance before any booking is made. Taxi fares are covered only when public transportation is unavailable after the event ends. Hotel costs require separate approval from Finance.

Submit the online claim within fourteen days of returning. Attach itemized receipts and the conference program; a credit-card statement alone is not sufficient. If a registration receipt lists several attendees, highlight your own name and share of the fee. Claims missing documents will be returned rather than held open.

Employees who receive a subsidy from a professional association must declare it. The company will reimburse only the remaining eligible expense. Beginning next month, paper claim forms will no longer be accepted. A drop-in demonstration of the online form will be held in the training room on the last Friday of this month, from noon to one.
groups.passageZh:
員工發展室
研討會費用申報：修訂流程

groups.title: Reservation system service review
groups.passage:
REVIEW: TABLEPATH FOR SMALL RESTAURANTS
By Ellis Park, owner of Juniper Kitchen

We switched to TablePath three months ago after losing several telephone reservations during a busy holiday weekend. The system has made it easier for our two front-desk employees to see the same booking calendar. Customers receive an automatic reminder the day before their visit, and missed reservations have noticeably decreased.

Setup was straightforward, although importing our old customer notes took longer than expected. TablePath's support team responded quickly and transferred the notes at no extra charge. The basic subscription includes online bookings but not deposit collection; that requires the higher-priced plan. We stayed with the basic plan because we take deposits only for large private events and can handle those separately.

My main criticism is the printed seating chart. The text is too small, and there is no way to enlarge it. We now keep a tablet at the host station instead. For an independent restaurant needing simple reservation management, I would recommend TablePath, but businesses requiring detailed event-planning tools should look elsewhere.

vocabulary.note: 確認場所讓不同需求的使用者都能進入使用。

questions.prompt: The gallery will remain closed ____ the lighting system has been inspected.

options.whyZh: 此處表達時間終點，而非對比。
until 表示關閉狀態持續到檢查完成。

questions.prompt: Applicants must provide two references, ____ of whom have supervised their work.
questions.promptZh: 應徵者須提供兩位推薦人，____曾督導其工作。

options.zh: 其……的（所有格關係代名詞）
options.whyZh: whose 表示所有格，不能在此接 of whom。
every 不能直接接 of whom。
twice 表示次數；此處須指明兩位推薦人中的哪些人，不是督導過幾次。

vocabulary.note: 可以提供工作表現評價的人。

questions.prompt: Please keep the original receipt so that the accounting team can ____ your expenses.
questions.promptZh: 請保留收據正本，以便會計部門____您先行支付的費用。

options.whyZh: 相似不能表達返還費用。
會計需依收據報銷，而非保留支出。
reimburse your expenses 指退還您先行支付的費用，收據正本是會計核銷的憑證。
招募的對象是人，不是費用。

questions.explanationZh: reimburse your expenses 指退還您先行支付的費用，收據正本是會計核銷的憑證。
questions.evidence: Please keep the original receipt so that the accounting team can reimburse your expenses.

vocabulary.note: 報銷時的支出證明。

questions.prompt: The revised brochure explains the membership benefits more ____ than the previous version.
questions.promptZh: 與前一版相比，修訂後的手冊更____地說明會員福利。

options.whyZh: 名詞不能修飾動詞。
than 要求比較級，且此處需副詞。
more clearly 是副詞比較形式，修飾 explains。
此處修飾 explains，應用副詞。

questions.explanationZh: more clearly 是副詞比較形式，修飾 explains。
questions.evidence: The revised brochure explains the membership benefits more clearly than the previous version.

vocabulary.note: 介紹服務或方案的印刷品。

questions.prompt: No refunds will be issued ____ the cancellation request arrives at least forty-eight hours before departure.
questions.promptZh: ____取消申請至少在出發前四十八小時送達，否則不予退款。

options.whyZh: 後面是完整子句，不能用 because of。
so that 說明目的；不予退款不會讓取消申請提早送達，這裡是在說明退款資格。
whether 在此不能單獨帶出退款資格的例外；它也不是「無論是否」的完整結構。
unless 相當於 if … not。取消申請未在出發前至少 48 小時送達就不退款；符合這個時間條件不等於保證退款。

questions.explanationZh: unless 相當於 if … not。取消申請未在出發前至少 48 小時送達就不退款；符合這個時間條件不等於保證退款。
questions.evidence: No refunds will be issued unless the cancellation request arrives at least forty-eight hours before departure.

vocabulary.note: 此處為行程開始的時間。

questions.prompt: The museum director thanked the volunteers for ____ assistance during the exhibition.
questions.promptZh: 博物館館長感謝志工在展覽期間提供協助。（英文空格測試形容詞性所有格。）

options.whyZh: 獨立所有格後不接名詞。
主格不能限定 assistance。
所有格形容詞 their 限定 assistance。
受格不能作此處的所有格限定詞。

questions.explanationZh: 所有格形容詞 their 限定 assistance。
questions.evidence: The museum director thanked the volunteers for their assistance during the exhibition.

vocabulary.note: 不可數名詞，指所提供的幫助。

questions.prompt: The supplier has agreed to replace any valves found to be ____ within six months of installation.
questions.promptZh: 供應商已同意更換在安裝後六個月內發現有缺陷的閥門。（英文空格測試表示「有缺陷」的詞。）

options.whyZh: 副詞不能在此作主詞補語。
此處 be 後需要形容詞，而非可數名詞單數。
意思不符產品故障情境。
be defective 描述閥門狀態，符合更換條件。

questions.explanationZh: be defective 描述閥門狀態，符合更換條件。
questions.evidence: The supplier has agreed to replace any valves found to be defective within six months of installation.

vocabulary.note: 控制液體或氣體流動的零件。

questions.prompt: Ms. Ortega will lead the workshop ____ Mr. Chen is attending a conference overseas.
questions.promptZh: 陳先生在海外參加會議____，奧蒂嘉女士將主持研習會。

options.whyZh: while 引導同時發生的活動。
表位置且不能接此子句。
介系詞不能直接接完整子句。
此處不能以 following 直接連接有主詞的現在進行式子句。

questions.explanationZh: while 引導同時發生的活動。
questions.evidence: Ms. Ortega will lead the workshop while Mr. Chen is attending a conference overseas.

vocabulary.note: 強調實作或專題學習的活動。

questions.prompt: Under the archive’s access policy, only employees with security clearance are ____ to enter the archive room.
questions.promptZh: 依照檔案室的門禁規定，只有取得安全許可的員工才____進入檔案室。

options.whyZh: eligible to enter 表示具備進入資格。
capable 通常接 of，不接 to enter。
familiar 通常用 familiar with 表示熟悉某人或事，不用 familiar to enter 表示准入資格。
probable 不能描述人獲准進入。

questions.explanationZh: 題幹談的是門禁資格。eligible to enter 表示有資格進入，而非具備能力、熟悉程度或可能性。
questions.evidence: Under the archive’s access policy, only employees with security clearance are eligible to enter the archive room.

vocabulary.note: security clearance 指安全審查後的授權。

questions.prompt: By the time the new branch opens in August, the company ____ all staff training.
questions.promptZh: 到八月新分店開幕時，公司____所有員工訓練。

options.whyZh: 過去進行式不符合未來情境。
過去完成式與未來 August 不合。
未來完成式表示在未來開幕時點前完成。
此處是在未來開幕這個基準點回看訓練是否已做完，不是描述固定的例行時程。

questions.explanationZh: 未來完成式表示在未來開幕時點前完成。
questions.evidence: By the time the new branch opens in August, the company will have completed all staff training.

vocabulary.note: 同一公司在不同地點的據點。
搭配過去發生的時間點，指出當時另一件事已經完成；本題是陳先生打開警示前，控制器就已關閉線路。

questions.prompt: At 9:05, the dashboard issued a warning about the backup line. By the time Chen opened the alert at 9:12, the controller ____ the line, so there was nothing left for him to switch off.
questions.promptZh: 上午 9:05，儀表板針對備用線路發出警訊。到了上午 9:12，陳打開警訊通知時，控制器____該線路，因此他不必再手動關閉該線路。

options.whyZh: 表示在當時之後才會切斷線路，與陳當時已無須關閉矛盾。
表示動作仍在進行；後文表示已無須再關閉，顯示關閉動作已完成。
警訊出現與陳打開警訊是先後的兩個時間點；後文顯示關閉在第二個過去時間點以前已完成，因此用過去完成式。
預期關閉不能證明線路在陳查看時已關閉。

questions.explanationZh: 警訊出現與陳打開警訊是先後的兩個時間點；後文顯示關閉在第二個過去時間點以前已完成，因此用過去完成式。
questions.evidence: The clock reference is past and the second clause requires completed automatic shutdown rather than a forecast or in-progress activity.

vocabulary.note: 引出可在週一啟動全部試產的必要條件：備援供應商須確認剩餘墊片會在週五前送達。

questions.prompt: Our current gasket supplier can cover only half the pilot order. We can still start all units on Monday, ____ the alternate supplier confirms that the remaining gaskets will arrive by Friday.
questions.promptZh: 目前的墊圈供應商只能供應試產訂單所需數量的一半。我們仍可在週一開始生產所有產品，____備用供應商確認會在週五前交付其餘墊圈。

options.whyZh: 即使備用供應商確認也能如期開工，沒有表達確認是一個必要的補足條件；「一半」讓補足缺料成為關鍵。
表示有無交貨確認都不影響全數開工，與現有供應量只夠一半矛盾。
會把確認交貨讀成阻止如期開工的條件，因果方向相反。
備用供應商若能確認及時補足缺料，所有產品才有足夠材料按期開工；provided that 表示後面的子句是前面結果成立的條件。

questions.explanationZh: 備用供應商若能確認及時補足缺料，所有產品才有足夠材料按期開工；provided that 表示後面的子句是前面結果成立的條件。
questions.evidence: Each connective can introduce the clause grammatically; the resource shortfall and the start of all units establish the positive condition.

vocabulary.note: only to + 動詞表意外或阻礙原來目的的結果；不表示當初採取行動的目的。

questions.prompt: Not knowing whether any kilns would be available, the community center called three studios hoping to reserve at least one kiln for Saturday, ____ that each had already booked its kilns for a market. After hearing the same answer from all three, the center will look for a Friday slot instead.
questions.promptZh: 社區中心事先不知道是否有可用的窯爐，因此致電三間工作室，希望至少能預約一座週六使用的窯爐，____每間工作室的窯爐都已為市集活動預約一空。三間工作室都給了同樣的答覆，因此中心將改找週五的時段。

options.whyZh: 打電話的目的是希望預約窯爐，不是去確認所有窯爐都已被預約。
only to + 動詞可引出與原本目的或期待相反的結果；中心原本希望訂到一座窯爐，打電話後卻得知三間都已沒有可預約的窯爐。
even after 把確認窯爐都已被預約放在致電之前；後文說致電後才聽到這個答覆。
後文指出三間工作室都給了相同的答覆，因此中心已得知窯爐都被預約，不是無功而返且不知道情況。

questions.explanationZh: only to + 動詞可引出與原本目的或期待相反的結果；中心原本希望訂到一座窯爐，打電話後卻得知三間都已沒有可預約的窯爐。
questions.evidence: Not knowing whether any kilns would be available, the community center called three studios hoping to reserve at least one kiln for Saturday, ____ that each had already booked its kilns for a market. After hearing the same answer from all three, the center will look for a Friday slot instead.

vocabulary.note: 每箱各有一個不同的序號；同一箱的箱身標籤和檢驗單標籤印相同序號，以便對應。

questions.prompt: For the pilot lot, each carton contains two labels, one for the carton and one for its inspection sheet. The serial number is unique to each carton and is printed on both of its labels. If a label on an inspection sheet is damaged, replacing it with one from ____ carton would link the sheet to the wrong unit.
questions.promptZh: 試產批次每箱附兩張標籤，一張貼在箱子上，另一張貼在該箱的檢驗單上。每箱的序號各不相同，同一箱的兩張標籤則印有同一個序號。如果檢驗單上的標籤破損，以____箱的標籤替換，就會讓檢驗單對應到錯誤的產品。

options.whyZh: 另一箱的標籤則用該箱自己的序號；混用會把檢驗單指向別的產品。
同一箱的兩張標籤序號一致，換用這一箱的另一張不會指向不同產品。
在這裡會指回標籤受損的那一箱；兩張標籤的序號一致，沒有更換對象。
範圍包含原本那一箱，但原箱的另一張標籤有相同序號，不一定會指向錯誤產品。

questions.explanationZh: 另一箱的標籤則用該箱自己的序號；混用會把檢驗單指向別的產品。
questions.evidence: The same-number rule only applies within a carton; the stated wrong-unit consequence requires a distinct carton, not the original or an unrestricted choice.

vocabulary.note: 後面可接動名詞；本題請使用者先不要在舊入口網站新增備註，因為這些備註不會移轉。

questions.prompt: The help desk says that the old portal will remain accessible during the transfer. Users can still look up an existing request, but they should ____ adding notes there until the new portal opens; those notes will not be migrated.
questions.promptZh: 服務台表示，移轉紀錄期間仍可使用舊入口網站。使用者仍可查找既有申請，但新入口網站啟用前，請____在舊站新增備註；這段期間的備註不會移轉。

options.whyZh: 若繼續在舊站加註，備註就無法隨紀錄移轉。
表示刻意做某事，反而會增添無法移轉的備註。
表示逐漸適應某個動作，但這裡要解決的是備註無法移轉，不是操作習慣。
hold off on + V-ing 表示暫緩某項行動；可以查閱但要等新站啟用才加註，避免備註遺失。

questions.explanationZh: hold off on + V-ing 表示暫緩某項行動；可以查閱但要等新站啟用才加註，避免備註遺失。
questions.evidence: The existing portal supports finding rather than adding migrated information; the specified end point requires temporarily postponing additions.

vocabulary.note: 班次售完時可先登記候補，但登記不等於已訂到座位。

questions.prompt: The Friday evening train is sold out. The clerk can add us to a waiting list now, but that will not guarantee us seats. Of the two trains, if we need guaranteed seats for Friday, we ____ book the earlier one, which still has room.
questions.promptZh: 週五晚間的列車已客滿。售票員現在可以幫我們登記候補，但不保證有座位。如果週五一定要有座位，這兩班車中，我們____訂較早班次的車票；那班還有空位。

options.whyZh: 取消搭前一班的必要性，但留下的晚班候補並不保證有座。
有座位是必要條件；較早的班次仍有空位，而晚班只能候補，因此在所列的兩個選擇之間就得改搭前一班。
較早的班次明示還有空位，故不能說無法預訂；此處要表達的是依照座位需求必須選較早的班次。
表示不願搭較早的車，但晚班候補無法滿足座位必要條件。

questions.explanationZh: 有座位是必要條件；較早的班次仍有空位，而晚班只能候補，因此在所列的兩個選擇之間就得改搭前一班。
questions.evidence: The conditional expresses necessity, not a casual preference; waiting-list eligibility and the earlier remaining capacity must be interpreted together.

questions.prompt: The revised delivery schedule is ____ on the availability of refrigerated trucks.
questions.promptZh: 修訂後的配送時程____冷藏貨車是否可用。

options.whyZh: is 後不能直接接原形動詞。
副詞不能作此補語。

此處主詞補語需形容詞。

questions.explanationZh: dependent on 表示以某條件為依據。

vocabulary.note: 配有降溫設備以保存貨物。

questions.prompt: Each of the winning photographs ____ displayed in the lobby next month.
questions.promptZh: 每張得獎照片下個月都會在大廳展出。（英文空格測試未來式被動語態。）

options.whyZh: Each 為單數主詞，不能用 are。
have 是複數形式，與 Each of ... 的單數主詞不一致；本句也指下個月才會展示。

options.zh: 將已（will have 為完成式助動詞）
options.whyZh: 後接 displayed 時缺少被動助動詞 been。

questions.explanationZh: will be displayed 為未來被動，符合照片被展示。

vocabulary.note: 可用被動式描述展品。

questions.prompt: The maintenance team identified the cause of the vibration after a ____ inspection.

options.whyZh: 需要形容詞修飾名詞，而非副詞。
介系詞不符合此結構。
through 可以表示「穿過」或「從頭到尾」，但不是此處與 inspection 搭配、表示仔細全面的形容詞 thorough。

vocabulary.note: 機械運作時反覆抖動。

questions.prompt: The committee has narrowed the search to three candidates, all of ____ have extensive management experience.

options.zh: 關係代名詞，指三位候選人

此處需關係代名詞連接子句，不能只用受格。
先行詞為人，介系詞後應用 whom。
whose 必須作所有格限定名詞。

questions.explanationZh: all of whom 引導補充描述三位候選人的關係子句。

questions.prompt: Guests who book directly with the hotel do not have to pay the usual breakfast charge. They receive a ____ breakfast.

comprehensive 表示內容完整或涵蓋廣泛，並未說明是否免費。
通常形容價格或能力，不表示免費招待。
